primitives.name: Signal Credibility Index
primitives.verbatim_quote: Method / model SCI_s = PR_s × (1 - TS_s) × (1 - HHI_s^flow) on logit prices, with weighted Cobb-Douglas SCI_s^(α) = PR^α1 (1-TS)^α2 (1-HHI^flow)^α3 (Σα_i = 3) and time-varying SCI(t;w) on rolling windows (w = 60 min recommended default; 90–240 min for ex-post).
primitives.assumptions: Logit-pricing of prices, uniform trader pool over regimes, signed flows from Dirichlet weights with regime-specific concentration.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When no trade occurs within a bin, SCI = 0.

layer2.mapping: SCI serves as a derived kernel for classifying line moves in GSE by combining persistence, disagreement, and flow concentration metrics.
layer2.telemetry: Probability of observing a given SCI value under simulated regimes.

primitives.name: Trade Disagreement Index
primitives.verbatim_quote: Method / model SCI_s = PR_s × (1 - TS_s) × (1 - HHI_s^flow) on logit prices, with weighted Cobb-Douglas SCI_s^(α) = PR^α1 (1-TS)^α2 (1-HHI^flow)^α3 (Σα_i = 3) and time-varying SCI(t;w) on rolling windows (w = 60 min recommended default; 90–240 min for ex-post).

primitives.name: Flow Herfindahl-Hirschman Index
primitives.verbatim_quote: Method / model SCI_s = PR_s × (1 - TS_s) × (1 - HHI_s^flow) on logit prices, with weighted Cobb-Douglas SCI_s^(α) = PR^α1 (1-TS)^α2 (1-HHI^flow)^α3 (Σα_i = 3) and time-varying SCI(t;w) on rolling windows (w = 60 min recommended default; 90–240 min for ex-post).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'HHI_s^{\\text{flow}}': 'dimensionless', 'Δv_{j,s}': 'net flow of trader j in bin s'}
primitives.assumptions: Trader flows are net position changes; normalization ensures sum-to-one property.
primitives.breakdown_regime: High concentration of flow yields HHI ≈ 1; dispersed flows yield HHI ≈ 0.

layer2.telemetry: Concentration measure of trader flows across bins.

The Signal Credibility Index (SCI) is constructed as a product of three components: Persistence Ratio (PR), Trade Disagreement Index (TS), and Flow Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI_flow). Each component measures distinct aspects of market microstructure—price persistence, disagreement among traders, and concentration of trader activity respectively. In GSE, SCI can be adapted to classify line moves by applying it to post-move windows of 60 minutes, using logit-transformed implied probabilities for PR calculation and signed flows for TS and HHI_flow. The index ranges from 0 to 1, where higher values indicate more credible signals. The operational classifier Ŷ_s(τ) = 1{SCI_s > τ} with τ* = 0.27 separates credible from non-credible moves in simulations. However, the SCI's weighting emphasizes coordination credibility over information content, which may misclassify certain regimes such as manip_then_info or coord_manip_broad. Therefore, GSE should recalibrate τ on real-world data and potentially reweight components toward information content.
